title: Rank of a work-tape reading pattern
statement: For each natural number $k$, assign a work-tape reading pattern—one optional Boolean symbol for each of the $k$ tapes—the position of that pattern in the ordered list of all such patterns. This rank lies between $0$ and $3^k-1$.
hypotheses_covered: A work-tape reading pattern with one optional Boolean symbol per tape
caveat: The ordering of the list of reading patterns is defined by an omitted auxiliary definition, so the rank's exact ordering convention is unavailable.
